description: This file defines a shared informer factory for Kubernetes API resources, including methods for creating, starting, stopping, and synchronizing informers, as well as configuration options.

classes.name: sharedInformerFactory
classes.description: Implements the SharedInformerFactory interface, managing multiple informers, their lifecycle, and configuration.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts all informers in separate goroutines, using a stop channel.

methods.name: StartWithContext
methods.description: Starts all informers with a provided context, allowing for cancellation.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Marks the factory as shutting down and waits for all goroutines to terminate.

methods.name: WaitForCacheSync
methods.description: Blocks until all started informers' caches are synchronized or the stop channel is closed.

methods.name: WaitForCacheSyncWithContext
methods.description: Blocks until all started informers' caches are synchronized or the context is canceled.

methods.name: InformerFor
methods.description: Returns a shared informer for a given runtime object, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: Core
methods.description: Provides access to core resource informers.
